Changelog

SafeVote 1.0.2 (2026-03-24)

CRAN release: 2026-03-23

  • Updated to allow regression against the current version (2.5-2) of vote – which had added a “weights” feature. The count of Dublin West ballots by vote 2.5-2 is so slow (approx 2 minutes on my laptop) that I have stored its results, and all regression tests now complete within 15 seconds.

  • Reworked the view routines

SafeVote 1.0.1 (2024-10-04)

CRAN release: 2024-10-05

DOCUMENTATION FIXES

  • I’m now person(“Clark”,“Thomborson”) rather than person(“Clark Thomborson”)
  • I have reformatted NEWS.md, as required by github’s pkgdown::build_news()
